items: Signature requests read as carefully as transactions

scenes.q: Why is a gasless "Permit" signature dangerous?
scenes.a: It can grant a token allowance without a transaction, so it's easy to sign without noticing. Drainers use it to take tokens.

scenes.q: How do you know a token is the real one?
scenes.a: By its contract address from an authoritative source, never by name or ticker.

scenes.q: When should you revoke an approval?
scenes.a: When you no longer use that protocol, or on a regular schedule.
